name: Amoeba Cover 1 Robber Lurk
formation: Amoeba Sugar Front vs 11P Gun 2x2 Mesh
coverage: Cover 1 Lurk (Man-Free with Underneath Hole Robber)

summary.motive: Show all-out blitz pre-snap to force quick man-beating throws (Mesh/Slants), then drop a linebacker into the low hole to bait and intercept the quarterback.
summary.whyItWorks: Offenses rely on crossing routes to beat man coverage, but the lurking linebacker operates without an assigned man, reading the QB’s eyes to rob the crosser.
summary.failureMode: Back-shoulder vertical shot plays down the sideline or deep double-moves that isolate the perimeter corners without safety help.

beats.title: Amoeba Sugar Blitz Look Pre-Snap
beats.text: Jesse Minter lines up both inside linebackers sugar-coating the A-gaps while safeties walk down, projecting an aggressive Cover 0 all-out house blitz.

beats.title: Post-Snap Disguise: Cover 1 Lurk Rotation
beats.text: At the snap, Minter sends a 5-man pressure with WILL blitzing the A-gap, while MIKE bails 5 yards back to become an unassigned "Lurker / Rat in the Hole".

beats.title: Mesh Crosser Trapped in Lurk Window
beats.text: The QB throws his trusted man-beater Mesh shallow crosser to H, believing he has leverage against trail-man coverage, but MIKE lurks right in the passing lane.

beats.title: Turnover Generated: Interception in the Hole
beats.text: MIKE steps in front of the shallow crosser for a game-changing interception, punishing the quarterback for reading the pre-snap blitz look.

relations.tell: Pre-snap sugar front rotates into Cover 1 Man-Free with MIKE squatting as a middle-hole robber on crossers
